definitions.explanation: A thin layer of ice crystals that forms on surfaces when the temperature drops below freezing.

examples.japanese: {今朝|けさ}は{霜|しも}が{降|お}りた。
{車|くるま}のフロントガラスに{霜|しも}がついていた。
examples.english: There was frost on the car's windshield.

examples.japanese: {霜|しも}が{降|お}りる{季節|きせつ}になると、{野菜|やさい}は{甘|あま}みが{増|ま}す。{特|とく}に{白菜|はくさい}やほうれん{草|そう}は、{霜|しも}に{当|あ}たると{美味|おい}しくなる。
examples.english: When the frost season comes, vegetables become sweeter. Chinese cabbage and spinach in particular become more delicious when exposed to frost.

notes:
{霜|しも} refers to frost - ice crystals that form on cold surfaces.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {霜|しも}が{降|お}りる (frost forms/falls)
- {霜|しも}がつく (frost forms on something)
- {霜|しも}に{当|あ}たる (to be exposed to frost)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {初霜|はつしも} (first frost of the season)
- {霜柱|しもばしら} (frost columns/needles in soil)
- {霜焼|しもや}け (frostbite, chilblains)
- {霜|しも}{除|よ}け (frost protection)

SEASONAL NOTE:
{霜|しも} is associated with late autumn and winter. 霜月（しもつき）is an old name for November.
